description: Curated skill reference documents for the AI Resume Analyzer knowledge base.

documents.title: Python Developer Skill Taxonomy
documents.content: Python backend development requires proficiency in FastAPI, Flask, or Django frameworks, async I/O, REST API design, Pydantic validation, and SQLAlchemy ORM.

documents.title: Database Systems & SQL Optimization
documents.content: Relational databases like PostgreSQL and SQLite require knowledge of index design, query optimization, foreign keys, ACID transactions, and migration strategies.

documents.title: Containerization with Docker & Kubernetes
documents.content: Docker containerization simplifies application packaging. Kubernetes provides container orchestration, automated scaling, ingress routing, and service discovery.

documents.title: Frontend Technologies (HTML, CSS, JS)
documents.content: Vanilla JavaScript, modern HTML5, and CSS3 enable building responsive user interfaces without reliance on complex single-page app frameworks.

documents.title: Cloud Computing Infrastructure (AWS & GCP)
documents.content: Cloud platforms like AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda) and Google Cloud Platform enable deploying microservices, blob storage management, and serverless compute pipelines.

documents.title: Git & Collaborative Version Control
documents.content: Git version control requires mastery of branching strategies (Gitflow), pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and release tagging.

documents.title: RESTful API Security & JWT Authentication
documents.content: API security includes stateless JWT token authentication, Bcrypt password hashing, CORS configuration, rate limiting, and input sanitization.

documents.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals with Python
documents.content: Machine learning engineering involves data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training with Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow, and evaluation metrics.

documents.title: Soft Skills: Cross-functional Leadership
documents.content: Technical leadership requires clear verbal communication, active listening, technical mentoring of junior engineers, and agile sprint planning.

documents.title: Soft Skills: Analytical Problem Solving
documents.content: Analytical problem solving involves breaking complex system bugs into reproducible isolation tests and formulating root cause hypotheses.
